snippet.title: Jump Space - Release Date Reveal Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom
snippet.description:
The official release date reveal for Jump Space - a mission based co-op PvE for 1-4 players set in deep space. It's coming to Xbox and PC in Early Access on September 19th. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #jumpspace
